name: The Hall
beats: A cold tiled hall. A long-case clock stands against the wall, and a worn mat lies before the study door.

exits.lockedBeat: The study door is locked, and the keyhole is dark.
The garden door is bolted from the other side.

name: The Study
beats: Books to the ceiling and a desk under the window. The curtains are drawn.

name: The Garden
beats: A walled garden gone to seed. One rose bush still holds a late bloom.
